name: Audit Tools
description: Send the audit log to your SIEM and export it as CSV or NDJSON.
features: Forward every audit entry to an HTTP collector as it happens
Catch up on entries written while the collector or Termix was down
Export the audit log as CSV or NDJSON with the same filters as the viewer
Spreadsheet formula guard on CSV export

env.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_URL
env.description: Collector URL audit entries are posted to. The URL set in the plugin's settings wins over this.

env.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token sent with the entries. Only used when the URL comes from this variable.
